plugins.name: The ROM Depot
plugins.author: MoveWeight
plugins.description: Browser-assisted provider. Searches a local export of the signed-in user's one-call /api/getContents directory tree and hands /api/download paths back to that user's browser, where the existing site session authenticates them.
plugins.terms: An account grants access under The ROM Depot's own terms, not a redistribution licence. The plugin indexes metadata the operator can already see and opens the site's own authenticated download route in that operator's browser.
plugins.comments: Installable as of 0.2.0. Sign in with a normal browser, save https://theromdepot.com/api/getContents, and set catalog_path to that JSON file. The plugin never accepts a username, password, cookie, or token and makes no network request during search. stream is a browser handoff to the percent-encoded /api/download/<path> route and is marked login-required/download rather than playable. No importer is declared because a ROM Hub host fetch would not have the browser cookie. Raw recursive API trees and ROMarr Capture's normalized {items:[...]} shape are both accepted; paths and catalogue membership are revalidated before every handoff.
